_default.zh: 暂无说明。可在 help-desc.json 中补充。
_default.en: No description yet. Add one in help-desc.json.

L0.zh: 主菜单：用两侧按键选择模块，CONFIRM 进入；PAGE 在本模块内翻页。
L0.en: Main menu: pick a module with the side keys, CONFIRM enters it; PAGE flips within a module.

page.display.zh: 显示设置：HUD 总开关、视场角、整体偏移、光标洞、俯仰梯、速度矢量，以及座舱 / 机头 / 地面三种自动隐藏条件。编队相关项已移到「编队」页。
page.display.en: Display: HUD master switch, field of view, layout offset, cursor hole, pitch ladder, flight path marker, and the three auto-hide conditions (cockpit / nose / ground). Formation settings moved to the FORMATION page.

page.camera.zh: 姿态与校准：俯仰零点、坡度方向与耦合、符号源，以及各校准动作（俯仰零位 / 坡度翻转 / 机体固连 / 状态复位 / 失速迎角）的触发键。俯仰梯与速度矢量不在这里，在「显示」页。
page.camera.en: Attitude and calibration: pitch zero, bank direction and coupling, symbol source, and the key that triggers each calibration action (pitch zero / bank flip / body-fixed / state reset / stall AoA). Pitch ladder and flight path marker live on DISPLAY, not here.

page.alerts.zh: 告警设置：失速迎角、迎角告警阈值、极速判定方式与阈值、低油量时间、机场/边界告警距离。
page.alerts.en: Alerts: stall AoA, AoA warning, overspeed mode and limits, bingo time, airfield and map-edge warning ranges.

page.keys.zh: 按键设置：显示隐藏、视角、地图、保存、光标洞等热键；选中后按 CONFIRM 进入捕获页重新绑定。校准动作的按键不在这里，在「姿态与校准」页。
page.keys.en: Key bindings: show/hide, view, map, save, cursor hole and the rest. CONFIRM opens live capture. Keys for calibration actions live on the ATTITUDE page.

page.panel.zh: 面板设置：文本颜色、高亮颜色（各 5 个预设）、拟真按键操作，以及界面语言（外板 / 屏幕 / 告警三处可分别选中英文）。
page.panel.en: Panel: text colour, accent colour (5 presets each), realistic bezel keys, and interface language (panel / screen / alerts chosen separately).

page.language.zh: 语言设置已并入「面板 / 语言」页。
page.language.en: Language settings moved into the PANEL page.

page.diag.zh: 诊断信息：各接口状态与延迟、机场数量、配置调试、更新检查与复制诊断文本。
page.diag.en: Diagnostics: endpoint status and latency, airfield count, config debug, update check and copy report.

lang.panel.zh: 外板语言：机框丝印按键文字使用的语言。
lang.panel.en: Bezel language: the silk-screen labels printed on the physical buttons.

lang.screen.zh: 屏幕语言：屏幕里列表、数值与提示文字使用的语言。
lang.screen.en: Screen language: every list, value and hint drawn on the MFD screen.

lang.alerts.zh: 告警语言：HUD 上 STALL / PULL UP / 返回战区 等告警文字使用的语言。
lang.alerts.en: Alert language: HUD texts such as STALL / PULL UP / RETURN.

lang.follow.zh: 跟随系统：开启后按 Windows 显示语言自动选择。
lang.follow.en: Follow system: pick the language from the Windows display language.

lang.reset.zh: 恢复默认语言：外板英文、屏幕中文、告警英文。需要二次确认。
lang.reset.en: Reset languages: bezel English, screen Chinese, alerts English. Asks for confirmation.

row.accentColor.zh: 高亮颜色：选中行、数值、发光条与按键描边使用的颜色。
row.accentColor.en: Accent colour: selected rows, values, glow strips and button outlines.

row.inkColor.zh: 文本颜色：屏幕正文（行名、提示、普通数值）使用的颜色。
row.inkColor.en: Text colour: normal screen text (row names, hints, plain values).

row.realisticKeys.zh: 拟真按键操作：开启后屏幕行不响应鼠标，只能用两侧实体按键与方向键。
row.realisticKeys.en: Key-only mode: screen rows ignore the mouse; only the physical keys and arrow keys work.

row.showHud.zh: 显示 HUD：叠加层总开关，关闭后仍运行但不再绘制。
row.showHud.en: Show HUD: master switch for the overlay; it keeps running but draws nothing when off.

row.formation.zh: 编队辅助：打开后开始显示编队引导（引导圈、速度条、油门条），并**同时切到精简界面** —— 只留航向带、编队引导和三个读数，其余 HUD 元素暂时隐去，把视野让给长机。关掉则两者一起恢复。飞密集编队时留着满屏俯仰梯反而挡视线，所以这一版把它们绑在一个开关上。
row.formation.en: Formation assist: turns on the guidance (ring, speed bar, throttle bar) and switches to the minimal layout at the same time - only the heading tape, the guidance and three readouts remain, everything else is hidden so you can keep the lead in sight. Turning it off restores both. They are bound to one switch because a full pitch ladder only gets in the way in close formation.

row.fov.zh: FOV 视场角：垂直视场角，用于把角度换算成像素。
row.fov.en: Field of view: vertical FoV used to convert degrees into screen pixels.

row.yoff.zh: 垂直偏移：整个 HUD 上下移动的度数，用来对齐视角。
row.yoff.en: Vertical offset: moves the whole HUD up or down to match your view.

row.pitchzero.zh: 俯仰零点：校准 HUD 俯仰线与真实地平线重合。
row.pitchzero.en: Pitch zero: calibrates the HUD pitch line onto the real horizon.

row.hole.zh: 光标洞半径：屏幕中心透明圆孔半径，越小越不遮挡飞行矢量。
row.hole.en: Cursor hole radius: transparent circle at screen centre; smaller hides less of the FPM.

row.tapeRadar.zh: 雷达高度带：机型支持时高度带优先显示雷达高度。
row.tapeRadar.en: Radar altitude tape: prefer radar altitude on aircraft that provide it.

row.ladder.zh: 俯仰梯：显示/隐藏俯仰刻度梯与地平线。
row.ladder.en: Pitch ladder: show or hide the pitch ladder and horizon line.

row.fpm.zh: 飞行矢量：显示飞行轨迹标记（FPM）。
row.fpm.en: Flight path marker: show the aircraft velocity vector symbol.

row.extrapolate.zh: 数据外推：在低频接口上做预测插值，画面更顺滑。
row.extrapolate.en: Extrapolation: predict between the low-rate API samples for smoother motion.

row.aimRmb.zh: 右键瞄准布局：按住右键时数据带外推、俯仰梯下移。
row.aimRmb.en: Right-button aiming layout: tapes move outboard and the ladder drops while held.

row.rollCouple.zh: 坡度耦合：补偿第三人称相机随坡度产生的旋转。
row.rollCouple.en: Bank coupling: compensates the third-person camera's roll as the aircraft banks.

row.bankSign.zh: 坡度方向：翻转坡度指针左右方向。
row.bankSign.en: Bank direction: flip the bank pointer left/right.

row.bankTrim.zh: 坡度微调：修正坡度读数固定偏差。
row.bankTrim.en: Bank trim: correct a constant bank offset.

row.fpmTrim.zh: 飞行矢量纵向偏移：微调 FPM 垂直位置。
row.fpmTrim.en: FPM vertical trim: nudge the flight path marker up or down.

row.pitchSign.zh: 俯仰符号：原生俯仰数据正负方向，可手动强制。
row.pitchSign.en: Pitch sign: force the sign of the native pitch data when auto-detection fails.

row.hideCockpit.zh: 座舱隐藏：进入座舱视角时自动隐藏 HUD。
row.hideCockpit.en: Hide in cockpit: hide the HUD in the cockpit view.

row.hideNose.zh: 机头视角隐藏：在机头/瞄准视角隐藏 HUD。
row.hideNose.en: Hide in nose view: hide the HUD in the nose/gunsight view.

row.hideGround.zh: 地面隐藏：停在地面时隐藏姿态类符号。
row.hideGround.en: Hide on ground: hide attitude symbols while parked.

row.groundSpeed.zh: 地面判定速度：低于该地速视为在地面。
row.groundSpeed.en: Ground speed threshold: below this ground speed the aircraft counts as parked.

row.groundDelay.zh: 地面隐藏延迟：达到速度后延迟多久显示。
row.groundDelay.en: Ground hide delay: wait this long after gaining speed before showing.

row.mapFlip.zh: 地图 Y 轴翻转：纠正地图坐标系方向。
row.mapFlip.en: Map Y flip: correct the map coordinate orientation.

row.edgeMargin.zh: 边界告警范围：距地图边缘多近开始闪烁 RETURN。
row.edgeMargin.en: Edge warning range: how close to the map edge RETURN starts blinking.

row.stallAoa.zh: 失速迎角：本机型临界迎角，超过触发 STALL。
row.stallAoa.en: Stall AoA: critical angle for this aircraft; exceeding it triggers STALL.

row.stallMem.zh: 失速记忆：已记录的每机型临界迎角数量。
row.stallMem.en: Stall memory: number of per-aircraft calibrated stall angles stored.

row.aoaWarn.zh: 迎角告警：AOA 超过该角度时变色提示。
row.aoaWarn.en: AoA warning: highlight the AoA readout above this angle.

row.bingo.zh: 低油量时间：剩余续航低于该秒数时显示 BINGO。
row.bingo.en: Bingo time: remaining endurance below this value raises BINGO.

row.endurance.zh: 续航标定：把估算续航对齐游戏读数。
row.endurance.en: Endurance scale: align the estimated endurance with the in-game readout.

row.afAlert.zh: 机场告警距离：距敌方机场小于该距离时 AF! 闪烁。
row.afAlert.en: Airfield alert range: below this distance to an enemy airfield AF! blinks.

row.overspeedMode.zh: 超速判定方式：按 IAS 或按 Mach。
row.overspeedMode.en: Overspeed basis: use IAS or Mach.

row.overspeedIas.zh: 超速阈值（IAS）：超过后速度数字变红。
row.overspeedIas.en: Overspeed limit (IAS): the speed readout turns red above this value.

row.overspeedMach.zh: 超速阈值（Mach）：按马赫判定时的阈值。
row.overspeedMach.en: Overspeed limit (Mach): used when the Mach basis is selected.

row.pitchMem.zh: 俯仰记忆：已记录的每机型俯仰符号数量。
row.pitchMem.en: Pitch memory: number of per-aircraft pitch signs stored.

row.keyShow.zh: 显示/隐藏 HUD 的按键（默认 F10）。

row.keyView.zh: 视角循环计数按键（默认 V）。

row.keyZoom.zh: 瞄准布局切换键（默认 Z）。

row.keyMap.zh: 按住显示地图的按键（默认 M）。

row.keyBrake.zh: 减速板指示键（默认 B）。

row.keyHole.zh: 光标洞尺寸循环键（默认 CTRL+ALT+H）。
row.keyHole.en: Cursor hole size cycle key (default CTRL+ALT+H).

row.keySettings.zh: 打开设置面板的键（默认 F1）。

row.keyExit.zh: 退出程序键（默认 F11，连按两次）。
row.keyExit.en: Exit the program key (default F11, press twice).

row.source.zh: 数据来源：原生姿态或合成姿态的当前判定。
row.source.en: Data source: whether native or synthesised attitude is in use.

row.configDebug.zh: 配置调试：显示配置来源与热键状态。
row.configDebug.en: Config debug: show the config source and hotkey state on screen.

row.dupKeys.zh: 重复键位检查：列出被多个功能占用的按键。
row.dupKeys.en: Duplicate keys: list keys claimed by more than one function.

row.copyDiag.zh: 复制诊断信息：把诊断内容复制到剪贴板。
row.copyDiag.en: Copy diagnostics: copy the current report to the clipboard.

row.diagState.zh: 接口 /state：飞行状态数据的延迟与有效性。
row.diagState.en: Endpoint /state: latency and validity of the flight state feed.

row.diagInd.zh: 接口 /indicators：航向、姿态、弹药等数据状态。
row.diagInd.en: Endpoint /indicators: heading, native attitude and ammo availability.

row.diagMap.zh: 接口 /map_obj：字节数与机场数量，排查机场指示消失。
row.diagMap.en: Endpoint /map_obj: payload bytes and airfield count.

row.diagInfo.zh: 接口 /map_info：地图基本信息是否可用。
row.diagInfo.en: Endpoint /map_info: whether the map metadata is available.

row.update.zh: 更新状态：检查结果显示在这里。
row.update.en: Update status: the result of the last check.

row.checkUpdate.zh: 检查更新：查询 GitHub 最新版本，只提示不下载。
row.checkUpdate.en: Check for updates: read the latest GitHub release version; nothing is downloaded.

row.leadMode.zh: 长机模式：打开后不追僚机，只按「长机马赫」保持自己的姿态，并且只报状态（编队完成 / 僚机掉队 / 距离过近）不给任何数字 —— 长机不该被引导去追僚机。关掉就是僚机模式：追到长机后方 400 m。注意两人必须约定好角色，都设成僚机会互相追。
row.leadMode.en: Lead mode: does not chase the wingman; it holds its own heading and Mach and reports status only (FORMATION / WINGMAN LATE / TOO CLOSE), no numbers - a lead should never be steered at its wingman. Off means wingman mode: close to 400 m behind the lead. Both aircraft must agree on roles; two wingmen will chase each other.

row.formationOmni.zh: 全向跟随（仅长机模式）：关 = 按锁存的航向直飞，偏离就提示转回；开 = 不锁航向，你可以任意方向机动，僚机按你的实时航向跟随。测试版建议打开 —— 这样长机想往哪转都行，不用先「转回设定航向」。
row.formationOmni.en: Omni follow (lead only): off = hold the latched heading and get a turn-back call when drifting; on = no heading lock, maneuver freely and the wingman follows your live heading. Recommended on for the test build.

row.leadIcon.zh: 长机机型（图标类别）：★ 只在数据链没生效（未启用或一个节点都收不到）时才用得上；数据链收到节点后改由位置配对认长机，这一项自动不参与。僚机默认认「离我最近的友军」当长机，战场上多一架友军就会被带偏。填上长机的图标类别（例如 Fighter / Bomber / Assault）就只认这一类。★ 这是类别不是具体机型 —— 两架都填 Fighter 区分不了，请让长机换个大类。留空则回到「最近友军」。
row.leadIcon.en: Lead icon (category): only used when the data link is not working (off, or no node heard yet); once nodes arrive, position matching decides the lead and this field is ignored. The wingman takes the nearest friendly as its lead by default, so one extra friendly in the area pulls the guidance away. Fill in the lead's icon category (Fighter / Bomber / Assault) to only accept that class. This is a category, not an exact type - two Fighters cannot be told apart; have the lead fly a different class. Blank falls back to nearest-friendly.

row.leadMach.zh: 长机马赫：目标马赫数（默认 0.70）。偏差超过 0.02 马赫时提示加速/减速。用马赫而不是空速，是因为它不随高度变化；实际比较时按当前音速换算成真空速。
row.leadMach.en: Lead Mach: target Mach number (default 0.70). A deviation beyond 0.02 triggers a power call. Mach is used instead of airspeed because it does not vary with altitude; the comparison converts it to true airspeed using the current speed of sound.

row.dataLinkOn.zh: 使用数据互联：打开后与同网段另一位玩家交换气压高度（UDP 广播 4 Hz，只传高度不传位置）。关掉就只用平面数据。Windows 防火墙首次可能弹窗，需要放行。
row.dataLinkOn.en: Use data link: exchanges barometric altitude with another player on the same subnet (UDP broadcast at 4 Hz, altitude only, no positions). Off means planar data only. Windows Firewall may prompt once.

page.datalink.zh: 数据链连接：开关、对端地址、发送目标、节点 ID，最后一行「链路状态」同时是实时读数和入口 —— 不改地址也能看到通没通，按确认进去看节点、角色、接口健康。关掉就回到只看平面数据的旧逻辑：有方位和水平距离，没有高度差。★ 编队要开数据链，但这一页管的是「连接」，编队参数在「编队」模块里。
page.datalink.en: Data-link connection: switch, peer address, targets, node id, and a LINK STATUS row that doubles as a live readout and an entry - see whether it is connected without leaving the page, press confirm for nodes, role and API health. Off falls back to planar data only: bearing and horizontal range, no height difference. Formation needs the link, but this page owns the connection; formation parameters live under FORMATION.

page.dataLinkStatus.zh: 链路状态的完整一页：接口健康、本机角色、链路状态、在线节点、僚机站位、端口、说明。和数据链连接页里的「链路状态」是同一份内容，从诊断页也能进来 —— 排查 8111 半初始化时不用先跳回数据链。全部只读，改不了任何东西。
page.dataLinkStatus.en: The full link-status page: API health, own role, link state, online nodes, wing positions, port, notes. Same content as the LINK STATUS row on the connection page, and reachable from DIAG as well - useful when chasing a half-started 8111 without jumping back to the data-link module. Read-only throughout.

row.wingSide.zh: 侧位：你在长机的哪一侧。左 / 尾随 / 右，**永远生效**，也是内外圈的判据（右转时右侧是内圈）。选「尾随」时横向偏移乘 0，等于正后方。多架僚机同一局要各飞不同侧位，否则会抢同一个点。
row.wingSide.en: Side: which side of the lead you fly. Left / trail / right - always active, and it decides inner vs outer turn (the right side is inner in a right turn). TRAIL multiplies the lateral offset by zero, putting you straight astern. In a multi-ship sortie each wing should take a different side.

row.formationWarnG.zh: 转弯告警阈值：长机转弯的横向过载超过这个 G 值，僚机的引导上方就显示「转弯过急」，表示队形跟不住了。默认 1.5 G（600 km/h 下约 5.1°/s）。实测：1.0 G 内外圈偏差 5–15 m（几乎完美），1.5 G 偏差 21–50 m（刚开始偏），2.0 G 内圈偏差 144 m（断崖）。调小 = 更早提醒，调大 = 更晚。
row.formationWarnG.en: Turn warning threshold: when the lead's lateral load exceeds this G, the wingman sees TURN TOO TIGHT above the guidance, meaning the formation can no longer be held. Default 1.5 G (~5.1 deg/s at 600 km/h). Measured: 1.0 G keeps 5-15 m error, 1.5 G 21-50 m, 2.0 G the inner wing falls off to 144 m. Lower = earlier warning.

row.fKp.zh: 外环比例：距离误差换算成「期望接近率」。默认 0.04。调大追得急、容易冲过头；调小追得慢、汇合更稳。改之前先确认不是在追一个十几公里外的 AI。
row.fKp.en: Outer loop gain: distance error to desired closing rate. Default 0.04. Higher closes faster but overshoots; lower is gentler.

row.fKpNear.zh: 近距比例：进入「远近融合距离」后，增益从外环比例渐变成这个值。默认 0.20。调大刹车更早、末段更稳；调小末段更软。
row.fKpNear.en: Near gain used past the blend distance. Default 0.20. Higher brakes earlier and steadies the last few hundred metres.

row.fKi.zh: 积分项，单位是千分之一：显示 6 表示 0.006。默认 6。作用是把稳态误差磨掉，给大了会来回振荡，一般不要超过 15。
row.fKi.en: Integral term in thousandths: 6 means 0.006. Default 6. Removes steady-state error; much above 15 it oscillates.

row.fKv.zh: 接近率增益：实际接近率与期望接近率之差换算成油门。默认 1.0。调大油门反应更猛。
row.fKv.en: Closing-rate gain: difference between wanted and actual closing rate becomes throttle. Default 1.0.

row.fBlendM.zh: 远近融合距离：距离误差超过它时用外环比例，接近后渐变到近距比例。默认 800 m。
row.fBlendM.en: Blend distance: above it the outer gain applies, below it fades to the near gain. Default 800 m.

row.fTau.zh: 油门指令的低通时间常数。默认 1.2 s。调大更平滑但更迟钝；小于 0.5 会让油门数字跳。
row.fTau.en: Low-pass time constant for throttle guidance. Default 1.2 s. Larger is smoother but slower; below 0.5 the number jitters.

row.fLeadFeed.zh: 转弯提前量总开关：打开后机头指向长机的未来位置。侧位僚机不受影响（站位点本身已含转弯预测）。
row.fLeadFeed.en: Lead turn feed: points the nose at where the lead will be. Side slots are unaffected - their station already rotates with the lead.

row.fLeadMin.zh: 提前量起作用的转向率门槛。默认 1.5 °/s。低于它不叠加，免得平飞时指针乱动。
row.fLeadMin.en: Turn-rate threshold before lead feed kicks in. Default 1.5 deg/s, so straight flight stays quiet.

row.fLeadMax.zh: 提前量上限。默认 45°。防止低速大转向率时把机头指到侧面。
row.fLeadMax.en: Lead angle cap. Default 45 deg, stops the nose being pointed sideways at low speed and high turn rate.

row.fMaxRatio.zh: 速度前馈上限（相对长机真空速）。默认 1.30。试过 1.60：15°/s 外圈变好，但 10°/s 内圈从 +71 翻成 −77，未采纳。
row.fMaxRatio.en: Speed feed upper bound relative to the lead's TAS. Default 1.30. 1.60 was tried: better outer at 15 deg/s but the inner slot flipped +71 to -77.

row.fMinRatio.zh: 速度前馈下限。默认 0.80。试过 0.50：10°/s 内圈减过头，未采纳。
row.fMinRatio.en: Speed feed lower bound. Default 0.80. 0.50 was tried and over-braked the inner slot at 10 deg/s.

row.fWingOffset.zh: 横向偏移（米）。默认 150：左僚机 −150、右僚机 +150；侧位选「尾随」时乘 0，这一项不起作用。与后距一起决定斜距 √(横偏²+后距²)。
row.fWingOffset.en: Lateral offset in metres. Default 150 (left -150, right +150). With SIDE set to TRAIL it is multiplied by zero and has no effect. Together with the back distance it gives the slant range sqrt(lateral^2 + back^2).

row.fStationBack.zh: 侧位僚机的纵向后距。默认 400 m，它是斜距的另一半（见「侧位横偏」）。下限 200 m：再近的话 4 Hz 链路的滞后就超过完成门槛（看上面「判定余量」那行），那个距离本来也是目视编队更稳。
row.fStationBack.en: Longitudinal distance for the side slots. Default 400 m; it is the other half of the slant range. The minimum is 200 m: any closer and the 4 Hz link lag exceeds the completion band (see MARGIN above) - at that range visual formation is steadier anyway.

row.fDoneHold.zh: 进入门槛需要持续多久才算完成。默认 2 s。防止只是掠过站位就报完成（长机会据此开始机动）。
row.fDoneHold.en: How long the band must be held before declaring the formation set. Default 2 s, so a fly-through does not trigger it.

row.fSteadyDeg.zh: 保持阶段的转向死区：偏差小于它就显示「已对准」，指针不再动。默认 5°（400 m 上约 35 m 横向）。调大更安静但会漏掉小偏差。
row.fSteadyDeg.en: Turn deadband while holding. Under it the cue reads aligned and stays still. Default 5 deg (about 35 m at 400 m).

row.fSteadyKmh.zh: 保持阶段的速度死区：Δv 小于它就显示「保持」。默认 20 km/h。调大更安静，但真正的速度漂移会更晚被发现。
row.fSteadyKmh.en: Speed deadband while holding. Under it the cue reads hold. Default 20 km/h; larger is quieter but hides slow drift longer.

row.dataLinkPeer.zh: 对端地址。留空 = 广播，只能同一局域网；填 ip:port 走单播，跨网段 / VPN / 组网软件必须填。多个用逗号分隔，改完立即生效不用重启。★ 收到的节点会被自动加进发送目标（谁发给我就回给谁），所以长机不必把每个僚机地址都填一遍。★ 广播地址 255.255.255.255 出不了路由器。★ 支持 IPv6：写成 [2001:db8::1]:48017，裸地址也可以（端口取默认）；链路是双栈的，同一个端口同时收 v4 和 v6。★ 地址格式不对的项会被跳过，看下一行「发送目标」确认实际发了几个。
row.dataLinkPeer.en: Peer address. Empty = broadcast, same subnet only. ip:port sends unicast, which is required across subnets, VPNs and overlay networks. Separate several with commas; changes take effect immediately. Nodes that send to us are added to the target list automatically, so a lead does not have to type every wingman address. Broadcast 255.255.255.255 never crosses a router. IPv6 works too: [2001:db8::1]:48017, or a bare address (default port); the link is dual-stack, so one port carries both v4 and v6. Malformed entries are skipped - check the TARGETS row to see how many are actually in use.

row.dataLinkPeerNow.zh: 实际生效的发送目标。broadcast = 广播；n target(s) = n 个单播目标；出现 bad 说明有地址格式不对（要 ip:port），那几项已被跳过。这一行读的是链路当前状态，不是配置里的文本。
row.dataLinkPeerNow.en: Targets actually in use. broadcast = broadcast; n target(s) = n unicast peers; bad means some entries were malformed (want ip:port) and were skipped. This reflects the live link, not the text in the field above.

row.holeX.zh: 光标洞中心相对屏幕中心的横向偏移（像素）。光标洞是 HUD 上挖掉的一块透明方形，把这一处的点击让给游戏——平时整块覆盖层都是穿透的，只有这里要显式让开，否则点不到座舱里的开关。正 = 向右。换了分辨率或窗口位置要重调。
row.holeX.en: Horizontal offset of the cursor hole from the screen centre, in pixels. The hole is a transparent square cut out of the overlay so clicks land in the game instead of being eaten. Positive moves it right. Re-tune after changing resolution or window placement.

row.holeY.zh: 光标洞中心相对屏幕中心的纵向偏移（像素）。正 = 向下。和「光标洞 X」一起定位，配合 Ctrl+Alt+H 循环改大小。
row.holeY.en: Vertical offset of the cursor hole from the screen centre, in pixels. Positive moves it down. Used together with CURSOR HOLE X; Ctrl+Alt+H cycles the size.

row.splashEnabled.zh: 击落播报：游戏报出「某甲 (机型) 击落了 某乙」时在屏幕上提示一行。配合下面的「玩家昵称」判断是不是自己击落的；昵称留空就只当旁观信息显示，不区分归属。
row.splashEnabled.en: Kill feed: shows a line when the game reports "A (type) shot down B". The nickname below decides whether the kill is yours; leave it empty and every kill is shown without ownership.

row.playerName.zh: 你的游戏内昵称，用来从击落播报里认出自己。中文昵称、中文联队标签（^雄鹰^张三）、昵称里带括号（张三(老阳)）都能正确匹配，标签会先剥掉再比。留空 = 不判定归属。
row.playerName.en: Your in-game nickname, used to recognise your own kills in the feed. Chinese names, Chinese squad tags (^X^Name) and brackets inside the name all match - tags are stripped before comparing. Empty means no ownership check.

row.rollCoupleMode.zh: 坡度耦合三选一：开 = HUD 跟着座舱一起滚（1:1）；关 = 不跟着滚，第三人称视角用；自动 = 当前实现里等同「开」。★ 坡度滚反了要用下面的「坡度方向翻转」改符号，改这一项没用。
row.rollCoupleMode.en: Roll coupling: ON rotates the HUD with the cockpit (1:1); OFF keeps it level, for third-person; AUTO currently behaves as ON. If the roll goes the wrong way use BANK FLIP - this row will not fix it.

row.keyPitchZero.zh: 俯仰零位校准键。平飞时按一下，把当前俯仰记成零点，之后俯仰梯对着真实地平线读 0。默认 F7。改完按 SAVE 才写进配置。
row.keyPitchZero.en: Pitch zero key. Fly level, press once, and the current pitch becomes zero so the ladder reads 0 against the real horizon. Default F7; press SAVE to persist.

row.keyBankFlip.zh: 坡度方向翻转键。HUD 的坡度方向和真实相反时按它翻符号，按一次翻一次（正负互换）。默认 F8。
row.keyBankFlip.en: Bank flip key. Inverts the bank sign when the HUD rolls the wrong way; each press flips it again. Default F8.

row.keyBodyFixed.zh: 纯机体固连开关。开 = HUD 固定在机体坐标系里，跟着飞机一起转、不做地平线稳定；关 = 正常按地平线稳定。默认 F9。
row.keyBodyFixed.en: Body-fixed toggle. ON locks the HUD to the airframe so it rotates with the aircraft instead of staying horizon-stable; OFF is normal. Default F9.

row.keyReset.zh: 状态复位键：清掉运行时的临时状态（视角、地图、计分板这类开关状态），不动任何配置项。默认 F5。
row.keyReset.en: State reset: clears runtime state (view / map / scoreboard toggles) back to initial. Touches no configuration. Default F5.

row.keyStall.zh: 失速迎角校准键。平飞减速到抖杆或失速，按一下把当前迎角记成失速迎角，之后 AOA 告警按它算余量。默认 CTRL+ALT+S。
row.keyStall.en: Stall AoA calibration. Slow to the buffet and press once; the current angle of attack becomes the stall reference the AoA alert measures margin against. Default CTRL+ALT+S.

row.spaaRange.zh: 友军防空（SPAA）在导航块里的显示距离上限，单位 km。0 = 不显示。默认 60。调大能看到更远的友军防空，但也更容易把无关目标塞进视野。
row.spaaRange.en: How far friendly SPAA is shown in the nav block, in km. 0 hides them. Default 60 - larger reaches further but clutters the view.

row.pullUp.zh: PULL UP 告警的提前量（秒）：按当前下降率和离地高度算，还有几秒撞地就报警。默认 5 s，可调 1.5–10。调大更早报（低空机动时会频繁响），调小更晚、更安静。
row.pullUp.en: PULL UP lead time in seconds: the alert fires when time-to-impact at the current sink rate drops below it. Default 5 s, range 1.5-10. Larger warns earlier and chatters during low-level manoeuvring.

row.sinkRate.zh: 下降率告警阈值（m/s），下降率超过它就报。默认 40。只影响告警，不改任何飞控行为。
row.sinkRate.en: Sink rate alert threshold in m/s; fires when the descent rate exceeds it. Default 40. Alerting only - nothing is flown differently.

row.keyHoldHide.zh: 长按隐藏 HUD 的键：按住临时隐藏（例如想看清目标），松开恢复。默认 U。
row.keyHoldHide.en: Hold-to-hide key: hold to hide the HUD temporarily (to see a target), release to bring it back. Default U.

row.keyFix1.zh: 固定组合键，不可改：CTRL+ALT+↑/↓ 把整块 HUD 上下移动 0.5°（改的就是「上下偏移」那一项）。飞的时候不用开面板也能调位置，调完按 SAVE 才存。
row.keyFix1.en: Fixed, not rebindable: CTRL+ALT+Up/Down shifts the whole HUD by 0.5 deg - the same value as the VERT OFFSET row. Reposition in flight without opening the panel; SAVE to keep it.

row.keyFix2.zh: 固定组合键，不可改：CTRL+ALT+PgUp/PgDn 改视场角 1°。PgUp 变小（符号更大），PgDn 变大（符号更小）。和「视场角」那一项是同一个值。
row.keyFix2.en: Fixed, not rebindable: CTRL+ALT+PgUp/PgDn changes FOV by 1 deg. PgUp narrows it (symbols bigger), PgDn widens it. Same value as the FOV row.

row.keyFix3.zh: 固定组合键，不可改：CTRL+ALT+R 在坡度耦合 0 / 1 之间来回切（第三人称 ↔ 座舱 1:1）。它改的是耦合数值本身，不改变上面的「坡度耦合方式」。
row.keyFix3.en: Fixed, not rebindable: CTRL+ALT+R toggles roll coupling between 0 and 1 (third-person to cockpit 1:1). It changes the coupling value, not the ROLL COUPLING MODE row.

row.importWt.zh:
从战雷导出的 controls .blk 读减速板 / 计分板的热键，省得手填。页脚会说结果：
「已导入」= 改好了，按 SAVE 保存；
「无需修改」= 本来就是这两个键（重复导入同一份文件会这样，不是出错）；
「只绑了鼠标/手柄」= 游戏里没设键盘键，手填；「解析到 0 个动作」= 文件选错了。
row.importWt.en: Reads the airbrake / scoreboard keys out of a War Thunder controls .blk. The footer says what happened: IMPORTED = changed, press SAVE; NO CHANGE NEEDED = both already matched, which is what re-importing the same file does (not an error); MOUSE/HOTAS ONLY = that action has no keyboard key in the game; 0 ACTIONS PARSED = wrong file.

page.formationTune.zh: 编队（通用）：两边都要用的都在这一页 —— 辅助开关、长机模式、队形、完成/掉队判定，外加三个入口：「僚机参数」放识别、站位、增益、油门与提前量；「长机参数」放航向、马赫、转向辅助；「数据链」放连接与状态。★ 长机模式是决定你是哪一边的开关，所以它留在通用页，不藏进角色页。
page.formationTune.en: Formation (shared): what both sides need - assist switch, lead mode, formation shape, done/drop gates - plus three entries: WINGMAN for identification, station keeping, gains, throttle and lead-turn terms; LEAD for heading, Mach and turn assist; DATA LINK for connection and status. LEAD MODE stays here on purpose: it decides which side you are, so hiding it inside a role page would make it hard to find.

page.formationWing.zh: 僚机参数（三级）：认长机（机型只在数据链失效时用、手填节点 ID）、站位判定（容差、保持死区）、垂直引导（门槛、升降率上限、远距例外）、跟随增益（Kp/KpNear/Ki/Kv/融合距离/低通）、转弯提前量与速度前馈上下限、长机转弯告警阈值。★ 这些是僚机独有的，长机页里没有；改之前先看每行的 HELP，都有实测依据。★ 数据链能收到长机时，水平引导直接按它自报的坐标算，不再依赖地图里的友机列表；但如果连自机坐标都拿不到（8111 半初始化、不在对局），只保留垂直引导并显示「无自机坐标」，不会拿上一帧的方位凑数。
page.formationWing.en: Wingman (third level): finding the lead (type only when the link is down, manual node id), station gates (tolerance, hold deadbands), vertical guidance (gate, climb cap, far-range exception), follow gains (Kp/KpNear/Ki/Kv/blend/tau), turn-ahead terms and speed feedforward limits, and the lead-turn warning threshold. Wingman-only - the lead page has none of these. Check each row's HELP before changing anything.

page.formationLead.zh: 长机参数（三级）：锁定航向、全向跟随、设定马赫、转向辅助（目标 G / 容差 / 按键 / 广播），最后一行是僚机自报的站位汇总 —— 谁掉队、掉多少（HUD 上按槽位列成表）。「编队完整」要求所有报到的僚机都在位，少一架没报到也不算完整。★ 长机不跑跟随环，所以这一页没有任何增益；那些都在僚机页里。
page.formationLead.en: Lead (third level): locked heading, omni follow, set Mach, turn assist (target G / tolerance / key / broadcast), and a live line of wingmen's self-reported stations - who is behind and by how much. The lead runs no follow loop, so there are no gains here; they belong to the wingman page.

row.leadHeading.zh: 长机锁定航向（度）：长机按它飞，僚机据此算前置。填 -1 = 不锁死，进入编队时把当时的航向锁存下来。打开「全向跟随」后这一项不起作用。
row.leadHeading.en: Heading the lead holds, in degrees. -1 latches the heading that was current when the formation was engaged. Ignored while OMNI FOLLOW is on.

row.dataLinkId.zh: 本机节点 ID，首次启用时随机生成并一直沿用。两端靠它区分彼此；显示「-」表示还没生成（把上面的开关打开就会写进去）。两台机器撞同一个 ID 概率极低，真撞了日志里会提示。
row.dataLinkId.en: This machine's node id, generated on first use and kept. It is how the two ends tell each other apart; "-" means it has not been assigned yet (turning the switch on writes one). A collision is very unlikely and would be logged.

row.dataLinkRole.zh: 本机在编队里的角色，由「长机模式」推导：开着 = 长机，关着 = 僚机。这个值会写进每一包报文的第 10 段，僚机端靠它认出谁是长机（不用再猜「最近活跃的那个」）。两台都开长机模式属于配置错误，对方会看到两个 role=1 并标「歧义」。
row.dataLinkRole.en: This machine's role in the formation, derived from LEAD MODE: on = lead, off = wing. The value rides in the 10th field of every packet so wingmen can identify the lead instead of guessing "the most recently active node". Two machines both in lead mode is a misconfiguration: the receiver sees two role=1 nodes and flags it as ambiguous.

row.fMapOnly.zh:
地图判定（数据链页，默认开）：数据链认出了长机、但地图上没有这架友机时，不提供水平引导，提示「长机不在图上」。
★★ 在全真模式对局关掉此开关后果自负 ★★
报文只有 4 Hz（1000 km/h 时滞后 70 m），读数偏了、队形散了，与本软件无关。
判定按米比：横向 120 m / 纵向 180 m 起，随距离放宽；200 m 内直接算看得见（图标可能因重叠而不画），判到后锁存 0.8 s 防闪。
row.fMapOnly.en: Map check (data-link page, on by default): when the link identifies a lead the map does not show, no lateral guidance is provided and the HUD says LEAD NOT ON MAP. **Turning this off during a simulator battle is at your own risk.** The report is only 4 Hz (70 m stale at 1000 km/h): if the readout drifts or the formation falls apart, that is not this software's doing. Matching is in metres - 120 m lateral / 180 m along, widening with range - and anything within 200 m counts as visible (icons can overlap). A hit is latched for 0.8 s so the hint cannot flicker.

row.dataLinkLeadId.zh: 手动指定长机：填对方的节点 ID，0 = 自动。★ 本机「长机模式」开着时这一项被强制忽略并显示 0 —— 自己就是长机，再认一个长机会让僚机端看到两个自称长机的节点。自动顺序是「手填 ID → 唯一自称长机的节点 → 场上只有一个节点 → 最近活跃」。三方以上编队、或两台都开了长机模式时自动会分不清，这一行就是强制手段。★ 填了就必须真能收到这个 ID，否则僚机侧会一直显示认不出长机——这是有意的，宁可明说，也不拿别人的高度顶替。
row.dataLinkLeadId.en: Manual lead selection: the peer's node id, 0 = automatic. Ignored (and shown as 0) while LEAD MODE is on this machine - you are the lead, and naming another one makes wingmen see two nodes claiming lead. Auto order is: configured id -> the only node claiming lead -> the only node present -> most recently active. With three or more aircraft, or when both ends run lead mode, auto cannot decide and this row is the override. It must actually be heard, or the wingman keeps saying it cannot identify the lead - deliberately, rather than substituting someone else's altitude.

row.apiHealth.zh: 8111 本地服务的健康度，只在飞行中判断。「正常」= 仪表和地图对象都有。「未就绪·请重启游戏」= 游戏启动时 8111 只起来一半：/state 有数据，但 /indicators 和 /map_obj.json 同时返回空，此时姿态会全部变成估算、编队也没有自机坐标，只有重启客户端能恢复（端口是通的，所以从外面看不出错）。「本机型无仪表」= 地图正常但没有航空电子数据，2.59 的部分新机型如此，属正常。「无地图对象」= 姿态正常但看不到友机位置。「不在对局」= 机库或主菜单，这一行不判断。
row.apiHealth.en: Health of the local 8111 service, judged in flight only. OK = instruments and map objects both present. HALF-READY / restart the game = the service came up only halfway: /state answers but /indicators and /map_obj.json both return empty, so attitude falls back to estimation and formation guidance has no own-ship position; only restarting the client clears it (the port answers, so nothing looks broken from outside). No indicators = map is fine but the airframe exposes no avionics data, normal for some 2.59 aircraft. No map objects = attitude is fine but friendly positions are missing. Not in battle = hangar or menu, not judged.

row.fWingMenu.zh: 僚机参数入口：识别长机、站位判定、跟随增益、油门与转弯提前量。摘要显示当前槽位和站位容差 —— 不进去也能核对你和队友是不是选了同一个槽位。
row.fWingMenu.en: Wingman entry: lead identification, station gates, follow gains, throttle and turn-ahead terms. The summary shows your slot and alignment tolerance, so you can check you and your wingman are not on the same slot without opening the page.

row.fLeadMenu.zh: 长机参数入口：锁定航向、全向跟随、设定马赫、转向辅助。摘要显示目标马赫；没设过就是「未设马赫」。
row.fLeadMenu.en: Lead entry: locked heading, omni follow, set Mach, turn assist. The summary shows the target Mach, or NO MACH when none is set.

row.dlConnMenu.zh: 数据链入口：跳到连接页改开关和地址。摘要只显示开/关，实时的链路状态在数据链页里那一行。
row.dlConnMenu.en: Data-link entry: jumps to the connection page for the switch and addresses. The summary only shows on/off; live link state is on the data-link page.

row.dlStatusMenu.zh: 链路状态：在数据链页里它是「实时读数 + 入口」—— 右边就是当前状态（off / no partner / linked #ID），按确认进去看接口健康、本机角色、在线节点、僚机站位、端口。诊断页顶部也有同一个入口，排查 8111 时不用绕回数据链。
row.dlStatusMenu.en: Link status: on the data-link page this row is both a live readout and an entry - the value on the right is the current state (off / no partner / linked #ID); press confirm for API health, own role, online nodes, wing positions and port. The same entry sits at the top of DIAG, so a half-started 8111 can be chased without detouring.

row.dataLinkWings.zh: 每架僚机自报的站位：`W1 ok` = 在槽位上，`W2 掉队 480m` = 比槽位远了 480 m，`W3 冲出 320m` = 冲到了槽位前面，`偏离站位` = 距离差不多但方位不对。★ 判定在僚机那一端做（只有它知道自己的槽位），长机只负责显示，所以两边不会各说各话。长机 HUD 上是一张逐架的表（`W1 到位` / `W2 掉队 480m` / `W3 偏离站位`），最多四行；这一行是落地复盘用的。老版本僚机不发这一段，显示 `-`。
row.dataLinkWings.en: Each wingman's self-reported station: `W1 ok` on station, `W2 behind 480m` 480 m further out than the slot, `W3 ahead 320m` past the slot, `off station` right range but wrong bearing. The judgement happens on the wingman (only it knows its slot); the lead just displays it, so the two ends cannot disagree. On the lead HUD the same data becomes a per-wing table (`W1 on station`, `W2 behind 480m`, `W3 off station`), up to four rows; this row is for the debrief. Older wingmen do not send this field and show `-`.

row.dataLinkTeam.zh: 异队过滤：因为**机场队标不符**被丢掉的包数，以及最后一次丢弃距今几秒。每架飞机在报文里报出「离自己最近的机场坐标 + 在我眼里它是不是友军」；收到时拿本机地图上同一座机场的颜色一比，颜色相反就是另一队，整包丢弃、不建节点。机场位置固定、两队看到的颜色相反，所以这条判据是稳的。**一直是「无」说明网段里只有自己人**；出现数字才需要确认是不是有另一队误进了同一个 VPN。两处细节：① 锚点只取**友军机场**（两边都永远可见），所以「我这边找不到这座机场」也直接算异队——**全真模式下敌方机场没点亮时不显示，正是靠这条兜住**；② 只有本机机场表还没读到时（刚进图）才放行，否则进图头几秒会把所有人断掉。
row.dataLinkTeam.en: Team filter: how many packets were dropped because the airfield anchor disagreed, and how long ago the last drop was. Each aircraft reports the nearest airfield's coordinates plus whether that field counts as friendly in its own view; on receipt we look up the same field on our map and compare the colour - opposite colours mean the other team, and the whole packet is dropped without creating a node. Airfields are static and each side sees them in the opposite colour, so the test is stable. A permanent NONE means only your own side is on the network; a number means you should check whether the other team wandered into the same VPN. Two details: the anchor only ever names a FRIENDLY airfield (visible to both sides at all times), so an airfield we cannot find is treated as the other team - that is what covers simulator battles, where enemy airfields stay hidden until spotted. Packets are accepted only while our own airfield table is still empty (just joined), otherwise the link would drop everyone for the first few seconds.

row.dataLinkNodes.zh: 在线节点一览，格式 `#节点ID 角色 高度 包龄`：角色 L = 自称长机、W = 自称僚机、? = 老版本没发角色。包龄是「最后一包到现在」的毫秒数，一直往上涨说明那个节点在丢包或已经掉线。联调时这一行比状态行更有用。
row.dataLinkNodes.en: Online nodes as `#id role altitude age`. Role: L = claims lead, W = claims wing, ? = old version without the role field. Age is time since that node's last packet; a rising number means it is losing packets or gone. More useful than the status line when testing a tunnel.

row.dataLinkState.zh: 链路当前状态。off = 没启用；no partner = 已启用但没收到别人（查端口、防火墙、对端地址）；linked #ID (by role) = 已认出长机，括号里是识别依据：by id 手填、by role 对方自称长机、solo 场上只有一个、ambiguous 有歧义（带 ! 号）。linked xN · #ID 表示同时有多个节点。这一行读的是运行中的链路，不是上面的配置文本。
row.dataLinkState.en: Live link state. off = disabled; no partner = enabled but nothing heard (check port, firewall, peer address); linked = one node; linked xN = several. Reads the running link, not the config text above.

row.dataLinkPort.zh: UDP 端口 48017，固定不可改。两端的防火墙都要放行它；同时开两个 HUD 会抢这个端口，后开的那个绑不上、一个包都收不到。
row.dataLinkPort.en: UDP port 48017, fixed. Both ends must allow it through the firewall; a second HUD instance fights for it, and the later one binds nothing so it receives nothing.

row.dataLinkDesc.zh: 数据链关掉时的退化行为：只剩平面数据——方位和水平距离仍然准，但没有高度差，编队圈的上下分区会一直空着。
row.dataLinkDesc.en: What happens with the link off: planar data only - bearing and horizontal range stay accurate, but there is no height difference, so the vertical sectors of the formation scope stay empty.

page.airframe.zh: 机型：每架飞机一套覆盖值。标了「按机型」的参数（失速迎角等）在这里选中机型后改的只对它生效；没有覆盖的机型仍用全局值。
page.airframe.en: Airframes: one set of overrides per aircraft. Parameters marked per-airframe (stall AoA and friends) are stored against the selected type; anything without an override keeps using the global value.

page.snapshots.zh: 回归快照：把当前配置存成一条带名字的记录，用来对比改动前后。选中一条按 CONFIRM 进入二次确认再恢复；列表由页面自己绘制，不走普通的两列设置布局。
page.snapshots.en: Snapshots: saves the current config as a named record so changes can be compared before and after. Select one and CONFIRM to restore, with a second confirmation. The list is drawn by the page itself, not the usual two-column layout.

row.formationShapeMenu.zh: 队形：进下一级页选形状（自定义 / 梯队 / 纵队 / 菱形）、槽位与高度偏移。值列显示当前队形和位置，例如「梯队 · 2」。
row.formationShapeMenu.en: Formation shape: opens the sub-page for shape (custom / echelon / column / diamond), slot and vertical offset. The value column shows the current pair, e.g. "ECHELON · 2".

row.fShape.zh: 预设队形：**只是一个填数按钮**，按一下就把下面的侧位 / 横偏 / 后距 / 高度填成一套标准值。梯队 = 每架再后 450、再左 250、再高 25；纵队 = 正后方每架间隔 400；菱形 = 左后 / 右后 / 正后。★ 数值才是真几何：改下面任何一行，标签会立刻变回「自定义」。切回自定义会还原你套预设之前的那套数值。
row.fShape.en: Formation preset: only a button that fills the four numbers below (side / lateral / back / altitude). ECHELON steps 450 m back, 250 m left and 25 m up per aircraft; COLUMN stacks 400 m apart astern; DIAMOND gives left-rear / right-rear / astern. The numbers are the real geometry - edit any of them and the label drops back to CUSTOM. Switching back to CUSTOM restores the values you had before applying the preset.

row.fSlot.zh: 僚机编号（1 起）。**只是编号**，不决定站位 —— 报文靠它让长机那张表显示 W1/W2/W3。三架僚机请选不同编号，否则表里会全是同一个号。站位永远由下面的「侧位」和三个距离决定。
row.fSlot.en: Wing number (1-based). Just a number: it does not set the station, it only lets the lead's table show W1/W2/W3. Give each wingman a different one. The station always comes from SIDE and the three distances below.

row.fSpacing.zh: 预设的基准间距（米）。改它等于把整个预设等比放大或缩小，形状不变，标签也不会变成自定义。梯队默认 450、纵队 400、菱形 400，每个预设各存各的。
row.fSpacing.en: Base spacing of the preset in metres. Changing it scales the whole preset proportionally - same shape, label stays on the preset. Defaults: echelon 450, column 400, diamond 400; each preset keeps its own value.

row.fSlant.zh: 本机站位到长机的斜距（水平面内）= √(横偏² + 后距²)，只读。到位判定与速度前馈都用它 —— 面板上看到多少，判定就用多少。
row.fSlant.en: Slant range from your station to the lead, sqrt(lateral^2 + back^2), read-only. Both the on-station check and the speed feedforward use it, so the number you see is the number being judged.

row.fSideM.zh: 本机站位相对长机的横向偏移（右为正）。只读，由侧位与横偏算出。
row.fSideM.en: Lateral offset of your station from the lead, right positive. Read-only, derived from SIDE and the lateral offset.

row.fBackM.zh: 本机站位相对长机的纵向位置（负值 = 在长机后方）。只读，等于后距取负。
row.fBackM.en: Longitudinal position of your station (negative means behind the lead). Read-only; the back distance with a minus sign.

page.formationShape.zh: 队形：上面是预设（填数按钮）与编号，下面四行是真正的几何输入 —— 侧位、横偏、后距、高度。中间三行只读值告诉你这个站位到底在哪（斜距 / 横向 / 纵向）。改任何一行数值，标签立刻变回自定义。
page.formationShape.en: Formation: the top rows are the preset (a fill-in button) and the wing number; the four rows below are the real geometry inputs - side, lateral, back, altitude. The read-only rows in between show where the station actually sits (slant / lateral / longitudinal). Editing any value drops the label back to CUSTOM.

row.turnAssistMenu.zh: 长机转向辅助：按一下开关按键，HUD 在屏幕下方画一条坡度横带 —— 绿标是当前坡度、琥珀标是按「目标过载」算出的目标坡度，下面一句告诉你多压一点还是回一点杆。再按一下关掉。方向不用选：第一次真实转向（转向率超过 1.5°/s）自动锁定左右。
row.turnAssistMenu.en: Lead turn assist: press the assist key and a bank tape appears at the bottom of the HUD - green is your current bank, amber is the target bank derived from the target G, and the line below says bank more or ease off. Press again to stop. You never pick a direction: the first real turn (turn rate above 1.5 deg/s) latches left or right.

page.turnAssist.zh: 转向辅助设置：开关按键、目标过载与容差，以及是否把目标坡度广播给僚机。只有长机模式会用这些值。
page.turnAssist.en: Turn assist settings: key, target load factor and tolerance, and whether the target bank is broadcast to wingmen. These only apply in lead mode.

row.turnKey.zh: 转向辅助的开关按键。默认 CTRL+SHIFT+T。按一下开始（此时显示「转向以锁定」），第一次真实转向后自动锁方向，再按一下关闭。改完按 SAVE 才写进配置。
row.turnKey.en: Key that starts and stops the assist. Default CTRL+SHIFT+T. First press arms it (the cue reads TURN TO ARM), the first real turn latches the direction, second press stops. SAVE to persist.

row.turnG.zh: 目标过载（G），默认 3.0，可调 1.2–9.0。换算成目标坡度 φ = acos(1/n)：3G 是 71°、6G 是 80°。★ 定得比飞机在当前速度下能维持的更高，提示会一直喊「多压一点」，而压到底也到不了。
row.turnG.en: Target load factor, default 3.0, range 1.2-9.0. Converted to a target bank: phi = acos(1/n), so 3G is 71 deg and 6G is 80 deg. If you set it above what the aircraft can hold at the current speed the cue will keep asking for more bank you cannot achieve.

row.turnTol.zh: 容差（G），默认 0.3。实际过载与目标之差在这个范围内就显示「坡度正好」，不再催你修。调大更安静，调小更严格。
row.turnTol.en: Tolerance in G, default 0.3. Within this band the cue reads ON TARGET and stops asking. Larger is quieter, smaller is stricter.

row.turnBcast.zh: 把目标坡度通过数据链发给僚机，让它们提前知道长机要转到多少度，而不是等看到转角再追。关闭只是少一段报文，不影响本地辅助。
row.turnBcast.en: Broadcast the target bank over the data link so wingmen know in advance how far the lead is about to roll, instead of chasing the turn after it starts. Turning it off only drops one payload field; local assist is unaffected.

row.turnBank.zh: 由目标过载算出的目标坡度，只读：φ = acos(1/n)。它不随速度变，所以比「目标转向率」更适合当主提示（同样 3G，速度不同转向率能差一倍）。
row.turnBank.en: Target bank derived from the load factor, read-only: phi = acos(1/n). It does not change with speed, which is why it is the primary cue rather than the target turn rate - the same 3G gives wildly different rates at different speeds.

row.turnStatus.zh: 辅助当前状态：OFF = 关；ARM = 已按下、等第一次转向来锁方向；R / L = 已锁右转 / 左转（反向超过门槛并持续 1 s 会自动重锁）。
row.turnStatus.en: Assist state: OFF = stopped; ARM = pressed, waiting for the first turn to latch a direction; R / L = latched right or left (a sustained reversal beyond the gate for 1 s re-latches automatically).

row.turnWing.zh: 数据链上收到的对方目标坡度。长机开着自己的转向辅助并勾选「广播目标坡度」时，僚机这一行会显示长机准备压到的角度；显示「-」表示没收到（对方没开辅助、没勾广播、或链路没通）。
row.turnWing.en: Target bank received over the data link. When the lead has its own assist running and BROADCAST is on, this row shows the bank it is aiming for; "-" means nothing arrived (assist off, broadcast off, or no link).

row.fDonePct.zh: 「编队完成」的距离误差门槛，单位是**槽位斜距的百分比**，默认 10%。400 m 槽位上是 40 m，梯队第 3 位（1545 m）上是 154 m —— 同一个百分比在每个槽位松紧一致。★ 2026-11-12 从绝对米数改成百分比，老配置里的米数不再生效。
row.fDonePct.en: Distance band for FORMATION SET, as a percentage of the slot's slant range. Default 10%: 40 m at a 400 m slot, 154 m at echelon slot 3 (1545 m) - the same tightness everywhere. Changed from absolute metres on 2026-11-12; old metre values no longer apply.

row.fAlignDeg.zh: 站位容差（度）：除了距离和速度差，还要看有没有真的站在槽位上。判据是「当前视线」到「理想站位」的夹角，站准时为 0。默认 5° —— 在 400 m 槽位上大约对应 35 m 的横向偏差。★ 只看距离时，「正后方 500 m」和「左后 45° 500 m」都会被判成到位，后者其实压根没进编队。设为 0 可关掉这一维（退回只看距离）。
row.fAlignDeg.en: Station tolerance in degrees: distance and speed being right is not enough - the aircraft has to be in its slot. The measure is the angle from the current line of sight to the ideal station, zero when parked there. Default 5 deg, roughly 35 m of lateral error at a 400 m slot. With distance alone, "500 m straight behind" and "500 m at 45 deg left-rear" both count as on station; the second one is not in formation at all. Set 0 to ignore this dimension.

row.fDropPct.zh: 掉出「保持」、退回「收敛」的误差门槛，同样是槽位斜距的百分比，默认 30%。必须明显大于「完成误差 %」，否则会在门槛附近来回切换状态（提示闪烁）。
row.fDropPct.en: Error band that drops the formation back to converge, also a percentage of slot range. Default 30%. Keep it well above DONE BAND % or the state will flip back and forth.

row.fUpM.zh: 站位高度（米，正 = 比长机高）。默认 0。任何队形都读这一项：垂直引导瞄准的就是它，改完标签立刻变回自定义。梯队预设会逐级抬高 25 m、菱形后位高 30 m，都是通过这一项写进去的。
row.fUpM.en: Station altitude in metres (positive = above the lead). Default 0. Every shape reads this value and vertical guidance aims at it; editing it drops the label back to CUSTOM. The echelon preset steps 25 m per slot and the diamond rear slot sits 30 m high by writing this value.

row.fVertFirst.zh: 引导模式。**一段式（默认）**：高度差再大也给全套引导 —— 圈、航向、距离、油门都在。**两段式**：高度差超过「高度到位门槛」时只留一条爬升率，圈 / 航向 / 距离 / 油门全关，爬进门槛后才恢复横向引导。只给距离、不告诉你往哪转，多数人觉得更难受，所以默认一段式。
row.fVertFirst.en: Guidance mode. ONE-STAGE (default) always shows the full guidance - circle, heading, range, throttle - no matter the altitude error. TWO-STAGE leaves only a climb rate once the error exceeds ALT GATE, suppressing everything lateral until the gate is met. Showing distance without telling you where to turn felt worse in practice, hence the one-stage default.

row.fVertGate.zh: 高度到位门槛（米），默认 30。**只有「两段式」才决定显示**：编队未完成且高度差超过它，横向引导全关；爬进门槛后横向才开始。退出用 60% 门槛（18 m）做迟滞，避免在边界反复切换。一段式下，这一项只影响「高度一致」的判定。
row.fVertGate.en: Altitude gate in metres, default 30. It only governs the display in TWO-STAGE: while the formation is not set and the error exceeds it, lateral guidance is suppressed; it resumes inside the gate. Exit uses 60% of the gate (18 m) for hysteresis. In ONE-STAGE, this value only decides when the altitude reads as matched.

row.fVertMax.zh: 爬升率建议的上限（m/s），默认 10。爬升由飞行员自己完成，辅助只给速率；不限幅的话差 300 m 会算出 45 m/s，飞机做不到。仿真里 120 m 偏差在 10 m/s 限幅下 17.5 s 收完。
row.fVertMax.en: Cap on the suggested climb rate, default 10 m/s. The pilot flies the climb; the HUD only supplies the rate. Uncapped, a 300 m error asks for 45 m/s. In simulation a 120 m error settles in 17.5 s at this cap.

row.fFarRange.zh: 只在「两段式」下有效：那种模式横向全关，这一项决定要不要补一行距离。单位米，**默认 0 = 任何距离都显示**；**-1 = 什么都不显示**；正数 = 只有超过这个距离才显示。一段式下这一行是灰的 —— 正常模式本来就有距离。
row.fFarRange.en: Only used in TWO-STAGE: that mode hides all lateral guidance, and this decides whether a range line is added back. Metres, default 0 (show at any distance); -1 hides it entirely; a positive value shows it only beyond that range. Greyed out otherwise, since normal mode already shows the range.

row.role.zh: 你是长机还是僚机。选「僚机#N」会一次写好四件事：辅助开关打开、数据链打开、编号=N、队形套上「梯队·N」。★ 只在角色真的变化时才套队形 —— 手调过数值再回来点同一个角色，数值不会被重置。切长机不动队形。
row.role.en: Whether you fly lead or wing. Picking WING #N sets four things at once: assist on, data link on, number = N, and the ECHELON preset for that number. The preset is applied only when the role actually changes, so hand-tuned numbers survive re-selecting the same role. Switching to LEAD leaves the formation untouched.

row.fMargin.zh: 完成门槛（斜距 × 完成误差%）对链路一拍的位移（当前速度 × 0.25 s）。延迟超过门槛时带 ✗ —— 这个距离上「到位」基本等不到，那是数据精度不够，不是你没飞好。500 km/h 时一拍约 35 m。
row.fMargin.en: The completion band (slant x done %) against the distance flown between two link packets (speed x 0.25 s). A ✗ means latency already exceeds the band, so ON STATION will practically never trigger there - data resolution, not your flying. About 35 m per packet at 500 km/h.

page.cfgMenu.zh: 编队配置的四种走法：广播给局域网里的队友、接收别人发来的、导出成文件、从文件导入。只传编队相关（队形数值、门槛、地图判定、机型过滤），不传按键和显示。
page.cfgMenu.en: Four ways to move a formation config: broadcast, receive, export to a file, import from a file. Only formation settings travel - never key bindings or display options.

row.cfgBroadcast.zh: 把本机编队配置广播出去（连发 3 包，端口 48018）。对方不用先开数据链也能收到，这就是「新装机上线就能飞」的入口。队标不符的包会被对方丢掉。
row.cfgBroadcast.en: Broadcasts this aircraft's formation config (three packets on port 48018). The peer receives it even with the data link off, which is the point. Packets from the other team are dropped by the receiver.

row.cfgInbox.zh: 收到的配置包（最多 4 个来源，30 秒过期）。值列出现「● N 个配置」就说明有人发了。进去先看是谁发的，确认页会列出会改你哪些项。
row.cfgInbox.en: Config packets received (up to four senders, expiring after 30 s). A bullet in the value column means someone sent one; the next pages show who and what would change.

row.cfgExport.zh: 把编队配置存成 .wtcfg 文件，发给队友或留档。文件里不带机场锚点 —— 换局换图之后必然对不上。
row.cfgExport.en: Saves the formation config as a .wtcfg for a teammate or for reference. No airfield anchor is written: it would never match after a different match or map.

row.cfgImport.zh: 从 .wtcfg 读入编队配置。挑文件这个动作本身就是确认，直接写进草稿 —— 仍然要按 SAVE 才落盘。
row.cfgImport.en: Reads a .wtcfg. Picking the file is the confirmation, so it goes into the draft - SAVE still writes it out.

page.cfgInbox.zh: 配置来源列表：每行是一台发过配置的机器，右侧是节点号（带 ? 说明队标没法校验）。进去才看得到会改什么。
page.cfgInbox.en: Senders that broadcast a config. The right column is the node id; a ? means the anchor could not be verified.

page.cfgConfirm.zh: 确认导入：对方是谁、什么机型、什么角色、队形是什么，以及会改你哪些项。确认后只改草稿，按 SAVE 才落盘。
page.cfgConfirm.en: Confirmation: who sent it, their type and role, the formation, and which of your rows would change. Confirming edits the draft only - SAVE writes it out.

row.cfgFrom.zh: 发送方昵称（没填就显示 IP）与机型。
row.cfgFrom.en: Sender name (IP when unset) and type.

row.cfgNode.zh: 节点号、收到多久之前，以及队标是否通过校验（? = 没带锚点或本机还没读到机场表）。
row.cfgNode.en: Node id, age, and whether the team anchor matched (? = no anchor, or no airfield table yet).

row.cfgRole.zh: 对方当时是长机还是几号僚机。长机发来的配置不会改你的编号。
row.cfgRole.en: Whether the sender was lead or wing N. A lead's config never overwrites your number.

row.cfgForm.zh: 对方当时的队形：预设名 · 编号 · 斜距。

row.cfgDiff.zh: 导入会改你哪些项（只列名字，最多 4 个）。「与当前一致」说明这份配置你已经有了。
row.cfgDiff.en: Which of your rows the import would change (names only, four at most).

row.cfgApply.zh: 把这份配置写进草稿。按 SAVE 才落盘，返回则丢弃。
row.cfgApply.en: Writes this config into the draft. SAVE persists it; going back discards.

row.cfgNone.zh: 现在没有可用的配置包。让对方在「配置传递」里按「广播本机配置」。
row.cfgNone.en: No config packet available. Ask the sender to press BROADCAST.

row.dataLinkLeadState.zh: 僚机现在跟的是谁：节点号 · 怎么认出来的（手填 / 角色 / 唯一节点 / 最近）· 多久前的一包。「无」= 数据链没开或还没收到任何节点。
row.dataLinkLeadState.en: Who the wing is following: node id, how it was picked (by id, by role, only node, most recent) and the age of the last packet. NONE means the link is off or nothing has arrived yet.
